payload.name: Preserve explicit creative process descriptions
payload.description: Use during extraction when a message explicitly describes how something was created, such as the manner or approach, and the candidate summary omits that process in favor of emotional reactions.
content: If a message explicitly describes the process or manner of creating something (e.g., 'embracing the creative process without restraint'), include that description in the event memory alongside any emotional summary. Do not omit the process details when the message also expresses feelings.

solves: Construction extraction may summarize an event by its emotional impact while dropping the speaker's explicit description of how they created something. This candidate teaches extraction to preserve the creative process or manner when it is explicitly stated, so future event memories retain both the emotional context and the observable process. It applies whenever a user describes the way or approach they used to make an artwork or similar creative work.
